title: Define LogStorage trait in usenet-ipfs-core
description:
Define the async LogStorage trait: `insert_entry(entry: LogEntry) -> Result<()>`, `get_entry(id: &LogEntryId) -> Result<Option<LogEntry>>`, `list_tips(group: &GroupName) -> Result<Vec<LogEntryId>>`, `set_tips(group: &GroupName, tips: &[LogEntryId]) -> Result<()>`, `entry_count(group: &GroupName) -> Result<u64>`, `has_entry(id: &LogEntryId) -> Result<bool>`. Artifact: core/src/group_log/storage.rs.

Acceptance: trait compiles; all methods are async; return types use a crate-local error type; no SQLite dependency in this file
